english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for the physical area around a person or thing.
Use this for the broader surrounding area or neighbourhood rather than simple proximity.
Use this when stressing the area all around a particular place or person, rather than simply somewhere nearby.

examples.english: Look around the house; flowers are planted everywhere in the surroundings.
examples.traditional: 你睇吓間屋周圍，種滿晒花。
